pages.text: $(italic)Dragon-blooded and ancient. Resilient and imposing, the Ryu shrugs off damage and heals from food.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Dragon Scales$() — $(item)25% damage reduction from all sources$(). Extremely durable.$(br2)$(bold)Draconic Scales$() — $(item)+4 max HP$(). Thick dragon scales add vitality.$(br2)$(bold)Draconic Vitality$() — $(item)Rapid healing when well-fed$(). At 18+ food, heal 0.5 hearts every 2 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Broken Wings$() — $(item)Slow fall$(). Not true flight, but a gentle descent.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon's Sight$() — $(item)Reveal all nearby entities with Glowing$(). 15-second cooldown.

pages.title: Draconic Drawbacks
pages.text: $(bold)Draconic Diet$() — $(warn)Non-meat food provides 50% less nourishment$(). Your dragon stomach rejects anything that isn't meat.$(br2)$(bold)Potion Resistance$() — $(warn)Healing potions are 50% as effective$(). Your dragon blood resists magical healing.$(br2)$(bold)Heavy Metabolism$() — $(warn)+25% hunger drain$(). Your massive body burns energy quickly.
